models_evaluated: prostate cancer needle biopsy detection model

links.outcome: Model performance after digitally adding contaminant tissue patches to slides
links.effect: All four models degraded with contaminants. DA balanced accuracy fell from 0.74 to 0.69 with 1% prostate contaminant. GA mean absolute error rose from 1.626 to 2.371 weeks with 10% bladder. Prostate cancer models had false positives, up to a 97% false positive rate.
links.quote: Every model showed performance degradation in response to one or more tissue contaminants.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the robustness/vulnerability of digital pathology deep learning models to tissue contamination artifacts, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or mitigation strategy.
